content.text: Now I’m the sorry one! Sorry I dropped off the conversation. Everything’s been going pretty well. I’ve been staying at my parents for the majority of the quarantine. Started off as dealing with a breaking up and not wanting to be alone, but I’m pretty sure my mother has given me enough passive aggressive pushes to feel confident in going back home soon. Haha. Just staying busy with work and planting plants. Watching too much TV, etc... what about you?
